job.title: Junior Frontend Engineer
job.url: pasted by the user (no URL supplied)

summary.text: Frontend Developer and Information Technology graduate (HUTECH) with hands-on experience building responsive web and mobile applications using Next.js, React.js and React Native, and translating product and design requirements into reusable, maintainable frontend code.

bullets.text: Build production interfaces with Next.js App Router and Server Components, using TanStack Query and TanStack Table for client-side data, with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
Translate detailed Figma designs into clean, responsive, semantic code, and build reusable components and libraries with maintainability and DRY principles in mind.
Collaborate in an Agile/Scrum environment and communicate in English with project stakeholders.
Clarified product requirements, designed the user experience, and implemented the frontend for web and mobile.
Wrote end-to-end tests with Playwright to ensure product quality.
Used Spec-Driven Development to turn product requirements into a fully functional 23-component application, with clear specifications and automated validation.
Designed and built the interface with Claude Design and Claude Code, running AI-assisted development and testing workflows through Playwright MCP.
Built a Playwright end-to-end framework in TypeScript on the Page Object Model, covering 21 test cases across 4 browser and device targets.
